ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.2.3 Lean Live V2.1
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Evidence-curated D.2.3 baseline for RimWorld 1.5. V2.1 consolidates S5.1 into the single S4 search hook and adds strict exact-type Train/Repair negative pruning for the current measured hot set. The DLL retains synchronous DoBill, Common Sense, merge and text-cache paths while excluding T34 fabrics, workers, dispatchers, Clean Pathfinding hooks and all validator, reachability or reservation replay. Final gameplay decisions execute live on the main thread.
